title: Narra 4.1.3
message: This release improves offline reading and playback, Library progress and deletion controls, account status refresh, and download reliability.
changelog: Downloaded books, audiobook chapters and anime episodes now reopen from Library without a network connection.
Opened manga chapters are cached for offline reading with saved chapter and page progress.
Book reading now retries temporary source failures and reuses local EPUB or PDF files when available.
Library history and saved items now show real progress and provide individual delete controls.
Audiobooks, manga and drama resume from the last chapter or episode instead of restarting.
Account status can be refreshed immediately, while ordinary accounts and guests remain on free access with ads.
Sign-up now confirms matching passwords and clearly calls out the SPAM folder for verification mail.
Anime video downloads keep their progress visible, preserve episode titles, and no longer leave the detail page.
Picture-in-picture controls are available in anime and drama playback.
Same-version update prompts are ignored and unavailable ad inventory uses an in-app promotion fallback.
